trigger_phrase_or_event: creator approved copy and asked to proceed with image creation
tooling_note: Parallel sub-agent spawning was not used because the active tool policy requires explicit user request for sub-agents. This room is simulated as separate named reviewers and recorded accordingly.

copy_lock.copy: When I say I want to do life with you, I mean:
Slow dancing in the kitchen, just because.
Choosing the boring parts, because they're ours.

visual_system_candidates.name: Ritual Evidence Montage
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Each slide stages one tiny ritual as visible Aachu/Zuv behavior, preserving the reference premise while making the carousel ownable.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Needs strong continuity so it does not become ten unrelated cozy images.

visual_system_candidates.name: Object-Led Domestic Still Lifes
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Closest to several supplied screenshots and easy to render.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Fails A Story because text and objects would carry the deck while Aachu/Zuv disappear.

visual_system_candidates.name: Photographic Screenshot Redraw
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Would preserve the reference most literally.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Copyright/style risk, UI residue risk, and not the A Story illustration language.

why_it_wins: It translates the outside reference into A Story's own engine: tiny life rituals become proof because Aachu and Zuv act inside them. The story stays recognizable, but the expression is original.
rejected_visual_patterns: same dark brown candlelit palette on every slide

visual_format_anthropologist.extract: Borrow only the mechanic: ordinary-love declarations over intimate daily scenes. Remove UI, external handles, exact frame shapes, and cinematic photo blur.

scene_evidence_director.requirement: Every slide must show a hand, eye-line, object movement, or body-distance cue that proves the line without relying on the text.

romance_blocking_director.requirement: Zuv must actively make room, choose, hold, dry, fold, or dance. Aachu must remain expressive and emotionally alive.

typography_and_aspect_director.requirement: Keep exact copy in upper-middle negative space for both 4:5 and 9:16. No text over faces, hands, chairs, mugs, lists, or socks.

generation_prompt_director.requirement: Use the master prompt, selected identity bundle, Observational Intimacy Premium style contact sheet, exact text, and screenshot references as mood-only.

harsh_visual_selector.repair: Proof slide 6 first. Block full batch if faces are generic, paper is yellow/parchment, text is wrong, or kitchen dance looks staged like a ballroom pose.
